title: The Ram Ran
lines: Ron has a ram. The ram is big.
The ram can run. Ron can not.
The ram got in the mud.
Ron did tug. The ram did not get up.
Mom got a hot bun in a pan.
The ram got up. It ran at the bun!
The ram got the bun. Ron got the ram.
Mom did hug Ron. The ram is not bad.

questions.ask: Where did the ram stop running?
questions.listenFor: In the mud. The story says it. If your child guesses, have them find the word mud and read that line again.

questions.ask: What finally got the ram to stand up?
questions.listenFor: A bun in a pan. Listen for the bun - tugging did not work, food did.

questions.ask: Do you think Ron should let the ram run loose again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are listening for a reason from the story, like the ram got muddy, or the ram likes to run.
